name: Skeinwell
subtitle: Knit & crochet row tracker
shortDescription: Count rows by tap or voice, link repeats and increases, follow your chart with a row highlighter, and learn if your yarn will last. Free, and on your device.
longDescription:
Skeinwell keeps your place while your hands stay busy.

### Count Your Way
Tap anywhere on the big number, press space on an iPad keyboard, or just say "next". Voice counting uses on-device speech recognition, so nothing you say leaves your phone. Haptics tell you something happened without looking.

### Counters That Talk to Each Other
Add as many counters as a project needs. Link them: "repeat 8 rows, 12 times" gives you a repeat counter that moves by itself every eighth row; "increase every 6th row, 10 times" buzzes and shows a banner on the right row. Type the instruction the way a pattern writes it and Skeinwell builds the counters.

### Follow Your Own Chart
Open a photo, screenshot or PDF of a chart you own. Skeinwell reads the row numbers in the margin on your device, then slides a highlighter band down the chart as you count. Charts that repeat start again at row 1 automatically. If the numbers cannot be read, drag two lines to align it yourself.

### Yarn That Knows Its Length
Log yarn in your stash once. Put a skein on a kitchen scale and Skeinwell turns grams into yards from the label. Reserve yarn for a piece and see a straight answer: enough, or short by how many yards, based on the rows you have done and the rows to go.

### Calculators with the Workings Shown
Gauge to cast-on counts, pattern stitch counts adjusted to your own tension, yardage from a weighed swatch, a pattern's yardage rescaled to your gauge, and an even-shaping planner that spreads increases or decreases across a round.

### See Where the Project Is Going
A timeline of notes, photos, goals reached and timed work sessions. A pace chart and a finish-date forecast that gets better as you knit. Turn any project into a share card.

### Private By Design
No account. Projects, charts, photos and notes stay on your device.
monetization: Free with ads, optional monthly ad-free
